answer: One identity locks 70 credit for a spiral ceremony slot on the harbor board. Each epoch a plume rises from the harbor beacon at random; in ten minutes it files a signed sighting of slot and plume height. Auditors check the plume table: copied sightings, wrong heights, or one key in two slots burn it. Spiral slots cost 42, then 42+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,039,000 for a 40,000 pool; a rented-slot ring collapses. Honest agents pay 42 once.
